notes: ⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium/Puppeteer). This is a Duda website builder platform site. The business listings are loaded dynamically via JavaScript and are NOT present in the static HTML. The page has a 'dm-bfs' (business for sale) module container, but actual listing data only appears after JavaScript execution. Selectors are estimated based on common Duda BFS widget patterns. URL supports pagination via ?page= parameter. Part of FCBB network.
